<div class="title" data-bbox="110 70 890 120"><h1>Synthesis of Novel Heterocyclic Compounds</h1></div>
<div class="header" data-bbox="110 20 500 40">Journal of Organic Chemistry, Vol. 12</div>
<div class="text" data-bbox="110 150 890 300">We report a concise route to functionalised pyridines starting from commercially available aldehydes. The sequence proceeds in three steps with an overall yield of 62&nbsp;%.</div>
